title: Learning to drive
instructions: Sam araba kullanmayı öğreniyor. Kaç ders aldığına ve sınav tarihine dikkat et.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: I'm learning to drive at the moment.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: I have a lesson every Tuesday and Friday with my teacher, Mr Hill.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: So far, I've had twelve lessons.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: Parking is the most difficult thing for me. I always get nervous.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: My driving test is next month, on the twentieth.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: If I pass, my mum is going to give me her old car.

questions.prompt: When does Sam have driving lessons?
questions.feedback: Salı ve cuma (Tuesday and Friday) dersleri var.
questions.evidence: I have a lesson every Tuesday and Friday

questions.prompt: What is the most difficult thing for Sam?
questions.evidence: Parking is the most difficult thing for me.

questions.prompt: What will happen if Sam passes his test?
options: He will buy a new car.
Mr Hill will give him a car.
He will drive to the beach.
He will get his mum's old car.
questions.feedback: Geçerse annesi ona eski arabasını verecek.
questions.evidence: my mum is going to give me her old car.
